search.snippet: The elemental talisman is a talisman that allows players to enter the elemental runic altars to craft elemental runes. The talisman can be combined with a gold tiara to make an elemental tiara for 40 Runecraft experience at an elemental altar, by using the tiara on it.

search.snippet: All talismans can be bound in this way, though elemental and catalytic talismans require a gold tiara instead. Talismans can be used to create combination runes and are consumed in the process.

search.snippet: The elemental talisman is an item that allows players to enter all four of the elemental altars which they must enter if they wish to craft elemental runes. Unlike all other talismans, it cannot be bound into a tiara. The four elemental altars are Air, Water, Fire, and Earth. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com Combination runes It cannot be used as the talisman ingredient required for crafting combination runes. Locate function Since it is connected to all four of the elemental altars, the locate function may try to find multiple altars that are the same distance away, rendering it completely dysfunctional and causing it to give the message "You cannot tell which direction the Talisman is pulling...". However, if the player is already close to one of the four elemental altars (that is, closer to one altar than the other three) the elemental talisman will begin to function normally, and guide the player to that altar with the usual "The talisman pulls to the North-East" type messages. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com Elemental talismans can be obtained as drops from the monsters of The Abyss. Although it is not common, it is fairly easy to obtain from the abyssal leech, which has extremely low hitpoints. The easiest way to obtain this drop is to use the fairy ring network (code A-L-R) to go to the Abyssal Area. After a while in the abyss, the monsters become tolerant of you, so if you stay in the same location while you're there, you can choose to fight only the leeches. You may also purchase one from other players, which may be an alternative method instead of killing Abyssal creatures yourself. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com The elemental amulet is an amulet requiring level 59 Magic to equip. It is made by combining the amulets of air, water, earth, and fire at any elemental runic altar. Doing so requires level 30 Runecraft and 500 of each elemental rune, granting 175 experience. It has been superseded in most cases by the wicked hood, omni-talisman and omni-tiara. Unlike regular talismans, it cannot be used to enter the rune temples with the left-click "Enter" function on the ruins; the elemental talisman must be used on the ruins to gain entry. An elemental tiara is a head slot item used in Runecraft. It is created at any elemental runic altar by using a gold tiara or elemental talisman on the altar with both in your inventory. This consumes the elemental talisman and yields 40 Runecraft experience. To force an update of this list, click here. For an exhaustive list of all known sources for this item, see here. An elemental talisman can be seen on the shelves in Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim, but it is not available for purchase. The talisman is on the shelf.
